# Air, cabin and fuel filters

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Draw a vacuum on the AC system and use a 2-foot breaker bar if necessary to loosen stubborn bolts. [t1052]

[Partial] Charge the system with R-134a freon by inserting two 12 oz cans into the low port. [t1052]

[Partial] Keep the freon can in ice water while filling and try turning it upside down if flow is sluggish. [t1052]

Inspect the low port tap for a piecing type seal. [t1052]

[Partial] Fill the air, cabin and fuel filter system from the low port using a Freon canister. [t1052]

## Procedure
